title: 广度收缩期间持续强势，广度修复当日再突破
decisionTiming: Use only T-close and earlier information; reuse the parent's single T+1-open entry attempt. No later repair day or future winner may relabel T.

marketRepair.differenceMeaning: D(u) is the percentage-point change in the fraction with positive raw 20-session return, on the fixed intersection of price-evaluable securities at u and u-5. Each u uses its own intersection; this is not daily advancing-stock breadth or one fixed six-day constituent set.
marketRepair.zero: Zero does not count as contraction; it is allowed as the immediately preceding non-expanding observation.
marketRepair.noLevelFilter: No threshold on medianAbsoluteReturn20 or amount: a repair may start while aggregate twenty-session returns remain negative.
marketRepair.dependence: Overlapping five-day comparison windows are dependent. Three negative signs are three observations, not three independent confirmations.

resilience.source: The unchanged independently audited market-state panel roles.jsonl.gz qState.
resilience.condition: qState is the exact string true for this strategy symbol on each of T-5..T-1; require all five, not only contraction days.
resilience.currentTrigger: Current T must already be a pre-active Top5 parent persistent-leader raw breakout candidate. Current Q and breakout remain inherited; no scan of another eligible pool.
resilience.meaning: Q is observed relative price strength, not demonstrated market influence, controller identity, theme leadership or capital accumulation.

gateSemantics.priority: Necessary evidence unknown takes priority over known failures; retain all known failed predicates. Complete valid coverage below 0.9 or failed sign/Q conditions gives false.
gateSemantics.unknown: Missing/invalid required numeric field, out-of-domain/nonfinite value, matched5.available false or nonboolean, explicit qState unknown, or insufficient target-calendar history. Booleans are never numeric observations.
gateSemantics.hardIntegrityFailure: Missing whole row, extra/duplicate/wrong-order row, wrong date/symbol/version/source binding, invalid qState enum or contradictory exact earlierDate aborts. Do not convert these integrity errors to filter unknown.
gateSemantics.warmup: Use exactly targetDates[max(0,Tindex-5)..Tindex] for market and max(0,Tindex-5)..Tindex-1 for role history. Missing pre-target rows are insufficient formation history, not fabricated warmup. D on first five target sessions is unavailable; earliest evaluable index is 10.
gateSemantics.noHiddenState: No best-day choice, episode anchor, retry, cooldown or post-hoc repair labels. Evaluate every T independently; negative/zero to positive sign crossing defines each mechanical repair event.
gateSemantics.finiteInputContract: Bound panel JSON was emitted with allow_nan=False. A nonfinite whole input row cannot satisfy that frozen integrity contract and may abort hashing, while generic pure predicates preserve unknown semantics.

selectionAndReplay.parentOrder: Preserve complete parent raw ranking and pre-active Top5. Filter after that original selection; do not rerank or backfill rank six, including after active exclusion.
selectionAndReplay.strategyAdmission: Admit original parent strategy rank k only when its compound market-repair and own-history resilience gate is true.
selectionAndReplay.controlAdmission: Original control rank k on the same date inherits exactly the corresponding parent strategy rank k gate. Do not evaluate the control's own Q for admission, compress ranks after filtering, redraw controls or change the parent hash salt.
selectionAndReplay.lineage: Every decision and admitted signal records own original sourceSignalKey and parent row/file hashes plus pairedParentSignalKey=[parentStrategyId,strategySymbol,T], original pairedParentRank and the strategy-owned gate evidence/hash. Strategy rows pair to themselves; control rows never mislabel the strategy history as their own.
selectionAndReplay.shortfall: If original control rank k is absent, retain original matching shortfall and separately count true strategy slots with missing controls. Do not substitute another control or delete the strategy signal.
selectionAndReplay.active: Fresh empty active map per new group. Only filled entry reserves the symbol. Target exit at T open releases T-close signal; unfilled entry does not reserve. A false/unknown new-entry gate does not change old holdings/exits.

apiContract.market: evaluate_market_repair(target_dates, target_index, market_rows) returns date,targetIndex,version,candidateId,marketGate,newEntryAllowed,predicates,failedPredicates,unknownReasons,history,certified=false,targetAchieved=false; exact aligned six-or-fewer rows.
apiContract.compound: evaluate_resilient_gate(symbol,target_dates,target_index,role_rows,market_gate) returns date,symbol,targetIndex,version,candidateId,signalGate,newEntryAllowed,marketGate,roleHistory,failedPredicates,unknownReasons,certified=false,targetAchieved=false; exact aligned five-or-fewer roles for that symbol.
apiContract.pureScope: Pure functions validate dates, source featureVersion, exact earlierDate, qState enum and required identities; no source IO, prices, returns, active positions or control sampling. Caller validates complete input population and lineage.

requiredRecords: All 484 market gates with full causal six-day evidence and source row hashes.
All 1057 parent raw candidates with compound gate evidence, including non-Top5 records; retain original ranks.
All parent strategy/control pre-active rows with admitted/false/unknown dispositions and explicit paired rank lineage.
All daily selection/coverage rows, full role-stream exact date/symbol population and EOF verification, fresh active dispositions and all original event outputs.
Separate market-gate counts, candidate-gate counts, per-group original/admitted/false/unknown/attempted/active-suppressed accounting and unmatched true strategy slots.

researchAccounting.interpretation: One fixed composite hypothesis, chosen after ten earlier development trials. Constants are predeclared, not empirically justified optima. This is adaptively reused 2022-2023 development data, not holdout evidence.
